thread:
sam: Heads-up — I'm going to apply a Terraform change that renames the secrets path for the staging overlay to support a shadow deploy. Quick sanity check before I queue the plan? tl;dr: path change from /infra/staging/service -> /infra/staging/shadow/service

jess: What's the impact on k8s overlays? Are SecretsManager/SSM paths referenced in kustomize overlays or via terraform data sources?

sam: They're referenced via terraform data sources and then consumed by ExternalSecrets in the staging overlay. Plan should show no replacement if we map aliases, but if we change the secret resource name Terraform will create a new secret (not rename in place).

leo: Can you paste the minimal diff you'll apply and list which services use that secret?

sam: Diff snippet below — most callers are the api and auth services in staging: 

```
# terraform (planned change)
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "svc_staging" {
  name = "/infra/staging/shadow/service"
  description = "Shadow path for staged secret swap"
}

# old name was "/infra/staging/service"
```

natalie: Are we doing a straight rename in state (terraform state mv) or creating a new secret and copying values? If it's the latter we need a canary rollout plan to avoid 503s.

sam: Intend to create the new secret, copy values, then switch ExternalSecret refs to the new path for the shadow canary namespace. After verifying, we'll promote and deprecate the old secret.

jess: We need gating: create a `shadow` k8s overlay that points to the new path only for the canary. Start with 10% traffic to the shadow deployment, monitor latency/error rates, then flip routing. Also check KMS key grants if the string/key context changes.

sam: Agreed. Kustomize patch I'll add to overlays/shadow: 

```
# overlays/shadow/kustomization.yaml
patchesStrategicMerge:
- secret-ref.yaml

# overlays/shadow/secret-ref.yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: service-secret
spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: aws-secrets
  target:
    name: service-secret
  data:
  - secretKey: credentials
    remoteRef:
      key: /infra/staging/shadow/service
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: plan succeeded for branch `shadow/secret-path` — no infra drift detected :white_check_mark:

leo: One more thing — if you want an in-place rename (no new secret), use `terraform state mv` to map old resource to new name. Otherwise Terraform will create new resource and keep the old. Which strategy do you prefer?

sam: Prefer create-copy then verify before removing the old. Less risk of accidental data loss if something goes wrong. We'll do `aws secretsmanager get-secret-value` + copy via CI job, then update ExternalSecrets.

natalie: Add a rollback playbook in the PR: steps to revert ExternalSecret ref back to old path, and k8s rollout commands. Also add a short checklist for KMS/IAM checks — we had a missed principal in last rotation.

jess: I'll add a preflight checklist to the PR template: 1) Confirm KMS grants 2) Verify IAM principals for external-secrets 3) CI copies secret and verifies checksum 4) Canary overlay deployed 5) Monitoring alert thresholds set

sam: Thanks. I'll open the PR in ~10m and ping @jess @leo for review. Targeting promote window Thu 09:00 PST.

leo: :ok_hand: On review. Can you ensure CI uploads `terraform plan -out=plan.out` and attach artifact to the PR so we can inspect planned actions?

sam: Yep — CI will save plan.out and infra-bot will post the artifact link in the PR comments.

infra-bot: infra-bot: plan artifact uploaded -> artifact://ci/1777777777/plan.out

natalie: During canary, run `kubectl rollout status deployment/service-canary -n staging-shadow` and keep a 1m health-check window after secret swap. If any 5xx, revert ExternalSecret ref and redeploy traffic back.

sam: Will add those commands to the PR description. Thanks everyone — opening the PR now.

jess: Thanks — ping when PR is up and I'll run through checklist. :thumbsup:
